extracted.name: Condensed Milk Ice Cream
extracted.description: An easy ice cream to make with condensed milk, evaporated milk, regular milk, vanilla, and sugar for a sweet and creamy frozen dessert.
instruction_lines: Combine condensed milk, evaporated milk, sugar, vanilla, and salt in freezer canister of ice cream maker, and stir well. Add enough milk to bring mixture to the fill line on canister. Freeze according to manufacturer's directions.
